full_judgment: 7. The amendment seeks to enhance the amount claimed in the plaint. At the end of the trial of the suit, the plaintiff will be entitled to a decree only if he is able to satisfy the Court in respect of his claim and will recover the amount which he is able to prove by adducing satisfactory evidence. The defendants will have every opportunity to disprove or minimize the claim of the plaintiff.
